messages:
sam_cust: Hey team — billing question. Invoice for Apr 5-6 shows ~600k tokens but Console usage (per-route) shows ~195k. We're on private VPC with redwood-meter-agent v1.4.2. Any ideas? :thinking:

maria_support: Hey Sam — sorry about that. Can you confirm agent version + config and whether the agent was offline/buffering during the window? Also paste the last 200 lines of agent.log if possible.

sam_cust: Agent config attached (summary):
```
agent_version=1.4.2
buffering: enabled
buffer_max_mb=50
flush_policy: periodic
token_counter: local
timezone=UTC
```
We did have a network blip ~Apr 5 03:10 UTC for ~90m and agent was offline then. I can get logs.

sre_jordan: thx. Two quick checks: 1) did you run any manual replays of buffered events after the outage? 2) do you have any custom tokenization hooks configured on the agent?

sam_cust: No manual replays — agent is supposed to auto-flush on reconnect. No custom hooks we know of.

meter-agent-bot: buffer_flush: requeued 4 partial_batches (ids: b34f, b34g, b34h, b34i) after reconnect at 2027-04-05T04:55:12Z

ops_tony: Requeued partial batches can cause duplicate incremental commits if the last-chunk metadata isn't deduped. Does the agent send a stable request_id per request?

sam_cust: Agent log excerpt: 
```
[2027-04-05T03:10:02Z] network error: connection lost
[2027-04-05T04:55:12Z] reconnect successful
[2027-04-05T04:55:13Z] flush: sending 84 events (4 partial)
[2027-04-05T04:55:13Z] http 200 {"accepted":84}
[2027-04-05T04:55:13Z] local_count +398120 tokens
```
That +398k jump is the rough delta that matches the invoice gap.

eng_mei: Interesting — two likely vectors: 1) tokenization mismatch (agent does a "local" token count before sending, using spi-tokenizer) vs our canonical tiktoken counts server-side, 2) partial-batch replay duplication: agent may have incremented local counters on flush and server also counted same requests after replay leading to double-counts.

maria_support: Can you run the reconciliation endpoint we added last month? POST to /internal/reconcile?show_events=1 for that agent id — it will list event hashes accepted vs counted. If you prefer we can run it from our side if you share agent_id.

sam_cust: Agent id is onprem-44a, sharing now in DM.

sre_jordan: While we wait, quick mitigation: set agent config `token_counter: server` and restart agent. That will stop local token increments and let server assert canonical counts on ingest. Also set `flush_policy: conservative` to avoid re-sending partial batches.

eng_mei: Actionable explanation: local tokenizers can diverge by ~2-4x for some long prompts due to different normalization and fallback rules. In your logs the agent reported +398k which equals the buffered replay size *local_count. Server-side canonical counts (from reconcile) show ~195k for the same event hashes. That matches the console numbers. So invoice reflects server counted tokens but because agent also incremented a local accounting metric (used by on-prem billing pre-aggregation) and we didn't dedupe on reconciliation, both were recorded for billing export.

maria_support: We're opening an internal support ticket to adjust your invoice if reconcile shows server as canonical. @eng_mei can you trigger a one-off reingest/dedup for onprem-44a?

eng_mei: yes — will run dedupe job and re-export billing. ETA 2-4 hours. Steps I'm taking:
1) run reconcile to get accepted event hashes
2) run dedupe against billing export to drop duplicates flagged as local-only counts
3) issue pro-rated credit and corrected invoice

ops_tony: Long-term fix ideas: ship agent with canonical tokenization (match server) or switch agents to not export local token totals for billing. Also improve partial-batch watermarking so replays are idempotent.

sam_cust: Thanks — appreciate quick triage. We'll switch to `token_counter: server` now and keep the agent on conservative flush. Please ping here when job is done. :thumbsup:

meter-agent-bot: reconcile started for agent onprem-44a at 2027-04-06T09:02:10Z

maria_support: Follow-up: after dedupe job completes we'll send a billing adjustment and a short postmortem detailing root cause and permanent mitigations.

eng_mei: dedupe finished; reconcile confirms duplicate local counts for 87 events = 402,032 local tokens vs 195,184 server tokens. Created credit of 206,848 tokens and triggered corrected invoice. I put the reconciliation report in the ticket.

sam_cust: Confirmed credit received. Thanks everyone.

maria_support: Closing loop — we'll include a patch in next agent release (v1.4.3) to default `token_counter: server` and add idempotency checks for partial_batch ids. Will announce in release notes. :white_check_mark:
